title: Why are people throwing mustard at LSU? A Lane Kiffin grudge
answer: Because of LSU's coach, Lane Kiffin. Tennessee fans have tossed mustard and golf balls at Kiffin since a 2021 game, and during No. 9 Tennessee's 27-13 win over LSU in Knoxville on Nov. 21, 2026, mustard packets, a mustard bottle and golf balls landed on the field and play stopped briefly.
body:
The mustard is a running joke aimed at one person: Lane Kiffin, now LSU's head coach. Kiffin coached Tennessee for a single season in 2009 and then left for USC, and many Vols fans never forgave him. When people online say "bring the mustard," they mean a trip to Neyland Stadium is about to get messy for Kiffin, not that anyone is hungry.

The tradition started on Oct. 16, 2021, when Kiffin first returned to Knoxville as Ole Miss coach. After a disputed fourth-down call late in the game, fans threw bottles, cans, golf balls and at least one mustard bottle onto the field. The game was stopped for about 18 minutes, a golf ball hit Kiffin, and Ole Miss won 31-26. Kiffin later joked about the mustard, and the yellow bottle became the symbol of the rivalry.

This year the joke was announced in advance. At SEC Media Days in July, Tennessee coach Josh Heupel quipped that local stores would be stocked with mustard and golf balls. On Saturday night, with 3:14 left in the fourth quarter, fans threw golf balls and mustard packets after a penalty they disliked, and a full mustard bottle followed. Staff cleared the field, the stadium announcer warned that more thrown objects would bring penalties against Tennessee, and the game resumed after a couple of minutes. Kiffin said afterward that he was "probably not" surprised.

The search spiked overnight because clips of the delay spread on social media right after the game. Throwing objects onto a field breaks stadium rules, and the SEC has fined schools for sportsmanship violations before, but as of Sunday no penalty for this game had been announced.
in_the_news: Tennessee beat LSU 27-13 at Neyland Stadium on Saturday, Nov. 21, 2026, in a game briefly stopped when mustard and golf balls were thrown toward Kiffin's sideline.
